newsitem.title: USA: Robbins & Myers sees Q4 EPS at $0.58-$0.61.
newsitem.headline: Robbins & Myers sees Q4 EPS at $0.58-$0.61.

text.p: Robbins & Myers expects fourth quarter earnings per share of between $0.58 and $0.61, due to a strong orders backlog and its recent Tycon acquisition, a company spokesman said Wednesday.
First Call's consensus estimate for the company's fourth quarter is $0.57 per share. The company earned $0.48 a share in last year's fourth quarter.
"Q4 should mirror Q3," Hugh Becker, senior director of investor relations, told Reuters. Robbins & Myers reported third quarter income of $7.9 million, or $0.61 per share, earlier Wednesday.
Becker said that the third quarter is typically the company's strongest quarter. He attributed the strong fourth quarter projection to "the acquisition plus good order activity of our markets."
Robbins & Myers said quarterly order activity remained at levels it saw in the first half of the fiscal year.

"This, coupled with good backlog and the expected contribution from our recently announced Tycon acquisition, should result in a solid performance for the balance of the fiscal year," company president Daniel Duval said in a press release.
